Who we are

A family-owned business, built for Tallahassee.

Exact Consulting and Concierge Services is a family-owned business proudly serving Tallahassee and the surrounding areas. Recognizing a growing community need for reliable housing solutions, we've cultivated strong relationships with private owners, real estate investment groups, and local property management companies.

We understand that finding the right home requires time and attention that many clients simply don't have. Our mission is to bridge that gap by managing the entire research and curation process on your behalf — from precise budget and pet-friendly alignment to application navigation.

What we offer

Two ways to work with us

To accommodate your timeline and level of need, we offer two professional service options designed to streamline your housing search.

Mission

Exact Consulting and Concierge Services delivers streamlined, custom-tailored housing curation for clients across the Tallahassee region with absolute integrity and meticulous precision. We eliminate the friction of relocation by expertly managing every operational detail — from precise budgetary and pet-friendly alignments to application navigation — ensuring a fast, transparent, and dependable path to your next home.

Vision

Place Connect strives to be the definitive regional standard for rapid, flawless relocation in Tallahassee and the surrounding areas, driven by unyielding integrity and exact precision in every housing match we execute.

Our approach

How we curate your housing search

Whether you subscribe to Place Connect or book a personalized consultation, the approach is the same.

Listen first

We start with your exact criteria — budget, preferred neighborhoods, layout, and pet accommodations.

Curate precisely

We filter and verify listings across our network of owners, investors, and property managers — no guesswork.

Guide the application

We walk you through next steps so applications move quickly and nothing gets lost in the process.

Core values

Precision and integrity, in everything we do

Precision

  • Meticulous CurationWe filter properties with exacting accuracy, matching your budget, location, layout, and pet requirements without compromise.
  • Operational EfficiencyWe eliminate wasted time by streamlining communication, clarifying application processes, and acting with speed.
  • Data AccuracyWe verify every property detail and point of contact, ensuring you receive reliable, up-to-date information.

Integrity

  • Uncompromising TransparencyWe provide honest assessments of properties, neighborhoods, and application requirements with no hidden fees or agendas.
  • Client AdvocacyWe prioritize your best interests above all else, acting as your trusted, objective representative in the Tallahassee housing market.
  • AccountabilityWe take complete ownership of the relocation process, delivering on our promises and protecting your confidential data.
